_note: Validation rules (spec 7C). Conditions are small registered functions in src/engine/validator/conditions.ts; messages, reasons, labels and fix texts live here.

rules.title: Value out of range
rules.message: {task}: {param} is {value}, but it must be between {min} and {max} {unit}.
rules.reason: Each parameter has an allowed range from the specification or the tool's data.
rules.label: STANDARD

rules.title: Required value missing
rules.message: {task}: {param} {what}.
rules.reason: A simulation cannot run with an empty or non-numeric value.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Scan window longer than scan interval
rules.message: {task}: the scan window ({window} ms) is longer than the scan interval ({interval} ms). A device cannot listen for longer than the time between windows.
rules.reason: The window starts once per interval, so it cannot be longer.
rules.label: STANDARD

fixes.equal: Set the window equal to the interval ({interval} ms)

rules.title: Packet does not fit
rules.message: {task}: {packet} {what}.
rules.reason: Packet types have fixed slot counts and maximum payloads.
rules.label: STANDARD

rules.title: Simulation window out of range
rules.message: The simulation window is {window} us, but it must be between {min} and {max} us.
rules.reason: The engine needs a positive window below the tool's limit.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Not supported by the device version
rules.message: {task} needs {need}, but the simulated device supports up to {have}.
rules.reason: A feature cannot be used on a device that predates the version that introduced it.
rules.label: STANDARD

fixes.raiseBt: Raise the device limit to Core {version}

rules.title: Band or bandwidth not allowed
rules.message: {what} is not allowed for {generation}. Allowed: {allowed}.
rules.reason: Each Wi-Fi generation defines the bands and channel widths it can use.
rules.label: STANDARD

rules.title: PHY or LE Audio not supported
rules.message: {task} uses {what}, which needs {need}. The device supports up to {have}.
rules.reason: Coded and 2M PHYs arrived in Core 5.0 and isochronous streams in Core 5.2.
rules.label: STANDARD

fixes.raiseBt: Raise the device limit to Core {version}

rules.title: Wi-Fi feature missing
rules.message: {task} needs {feature}, which {generation} does not have.
rules.reason: Target Wake Time arrived with Wi-Fi 6 and multi-link operation with Wi-Fi 7.
rules.label: STANDARD

rules.title: No frequency overlap with Bluetooth
rules.message: {count} Wi-Fi task(s) run on {band} GHz, which does not overlap Bluetooth in frequency. Only shared antenna, shared core and isolation will cause interaction.
rules.reason: 5 and 6 GHz do not overlap the 2.4 GHz Bluetooth band; interaction is through the platform only.
rules.label: STANDARD

fixes.use24: Move Wi-Fi to the 2.4 GHz band

rules.title: Access point and station on one device
rules.message: Access-point tasks ({ap}) and station tasks ({sta}) are both selected, but the device is set to a single Wi-Fi role.
rules.reason: A device needs multi-role support to be an access point and a station together.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

fixes.enableMultiRole: Allow Wi-Fi multi-role on this device

rules.title: Two voice links clash
rules.message: {a} and {b} both reserve slots {slots} of every {interval}. Classic Bluetooth cannot send two links in the same reserved slots.
rules.reason: Reserved slots are exclusive to one link.
rules.label: STANDARD

rules.title: Tasks that exclude each other
rules.message: {a} and {b} cannot be selected together. {why}
rules.reason: This pair is marked exclusive in the rule table.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Too many at once
rules.message: {count} {what} are selected, but the device supports {limit}. {why}
rules.reason: Controllers limit how many of these can run at once. The limit is editable.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Audio and a voice call together
rules.message: {audio} and {voice} are selected together. This is common: the call normally takes priority, and the audio stream is reduced or paused.
rules.reason: How the audio behaves during a call is a product choice.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

fixes.reduceAudio: Keep {task} running at a lower bitrate

rules.title: Possible duplicate
rules.message: {task} is selected twice with identical settings. This is probably a mistake.
rules.reason: Identical tasks add airtime without teaching anything new.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Too many tasks to read
rules.message: {bt} Bluetooth and {wifi} Wi-Fi tasks are selected. With this many the view becomes hard to read.
rules.reason: A busy view hides the point of a demo.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Channels cannot coexist on one radio
rules.message: {a} is on channel {chA} at {bwA} MHz but {b} is on channel {chB} at {bwB} MHz. A single radio without concurrent operation cannot be on both.
rules.reason: A single Wi-Fi radio is tuned to one channel and width at a time.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Classic slot budget over-subscribed
rules.message: The reserved slots of {links} need {pct}% of the available slots, which is more than 100%.
rules.reason: Slots are shared by all links; reservations cannot exceed what exists.
rules.label: STANDARD

fixes.lengthenInterval: Lengthen the interval of {task} to {interval} slots

rules.title: Little room left for data
rules.message: The reserved slots of {links} use {pct}% of the available slots, leaving little room for data traffic.
rules.reason: Above about 80% reserved, data links are starved.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

fixes.lengthenInterval: Lengthen the interval of {task} to {interval} slots

rules.title: More airtime requested than exists
rules.message: {tech} tasks request about {pct}% of the window. {heavy} asks for the most.
rules.reason: A single radio cannot transmit more than 100% of the time.
rules.label: STANDARD

rules.title: Window will be saturated
rules.message: {tech} tasks request about {pct}% of the window, so most of the view will be saturated.
rules.reason: High load hides individual conflicts.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Cores cannot serve the selection
rules.message: One core in time-division mode cannot send Wi-Fi and receive Bluetooth at the same moment, but simultaneous Wi-Fi TX with Bluetooth RX is switched on.
rules.reason: A single time-division core serves one radio at a time.
rules.label: STANDARD

fixes.turnOffSimultaneous: Turn off simultaneous Wi-Fi TX with Bluetooth RX

rules.title: Platform settings contradict each other
rules.message: The platform is inconsistent: {what}.
rules.reason: Settings that describe the same hardware must agree.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

fixes.matchFem: Change the front-end to match the antenna mode

rules.title: Isolation out of range
rules.message: Isolation is {value} dB, but it must be between {min} and {max} dB.
rules.reason: The tool models isolation as a simple number from 0 to 100 dB.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Concurrency with low isolation
rules.message: Concurrent operation is on, but isolation ({isolation} dB) is below the interaction threshold ({threshold} dB). Expect degraded conflicts. This may be the point of the demo.
rules.reason: Below the threshold, a transmitter desensitises a nearby receiver.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Adaptive hopping has nothing to avoid
rules.message: Adaptive frequency hopping is on, but no Wi-Fi task is selected, so it has no effect.
rules.reason: AFH avoids Wi-Fi channels; without Wi-Fi it changes nothing.
rules.label: STANDARD

rules.title: Hopping minimum too high
rules.message: The adaptive hopping minimum ({min} channels) is more than the {outside} channels outside the Wi-Fi footprint plus the allowed minimum ({allowedMin}), a limit of {limit}.
rules.reason: The map cannot keep more channels than exist outside the Wi-Fi channel without keeping some inside it.
rules.label: STANDARD

rules.title: Time-share settings invalid
rules.message: Time share needs a Bluetooth share above 0 and below 100 percent and a slice length between 1 us and the window. Current: {ratio}% and {slice} us.
rules.reason: A time slice must be positive and fit in the window.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Window too short for a task
rules.message: {task} repeats every {interval} us, so the {window} us window shows fewer than two events.
rules.reason: Seeing one event does not show the repeating pattern.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Too many blocks
rules.message: About {blocks} blocks would be generated, which is above the limit of {limit}. {heavy} produces the most.
rules.reason: Very large runs would freeze the browser.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES

rules.title: Dense view
rules.message: About {blocks} blocks will be generated. The view will use density mode when zoomed out.
rules.reason: Above {limit} blocks the time view merges blocks into density bars.
rules.label: IMPLEMENTATION_VARIES
